one_liner: Senior team-lead contracting officer role at DISA, Fort Meade: leading contract specialists through solicitations, negotiations, awards and administration of IT contracts.
fit_summary: This GS-14 requires a year at GS-13 level planning, soliciting, negotiating and administering contracts. Daniel's contracting-related work is contractor-side proposal writing and supply purchasing at IEM, far below this level, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public under DoD Direct Hire Authority (5 USC 9905); veterans' preference does not apply.
Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution is required for the 1102 series (the pre-2000 exemption won't apply to you).

One year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-13: planning acquisitions, writing acquisition documents, and soliciting, evaluating, negotiating and administering contracts. Education cannot substitute.
Must be able to obtain a Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) clearance.
Applications are taken by email under Announcement 13069410.
strategy: Skip this one: his proposal and purchasing work at IEM doesn't add up to a year of GS-13-level contracting.
Target entry or developmental 1102 roles instead, such as GS-7/9 contract specialist positions open to the public, where his contractor-side proposal work can count.
resume_bullets: Found multimillion-dollar opportunities in SAM.gov and GovWin and led proposal writing (2019–2024).
Led a five-person intake center for ReBuild NC after Hurricane Matthew (2019).
interview_questions: Walk us through a complex acquisition you planned from requirement through award.
How have you led a team of contract specialists under competing deadlines?
Describe a negotiation with a contractor and how you reached a fair and reasonable price.
How do you assess contractor performance and handle a non-performing contractor?
watch_outs: Specialized experience is strict and can't be waived or substituted with education. Overstating qualifications can get you removed from consideration.
A bachelor's degree is mandatory. His M.A. implies one, but the experience requirement is the real barrier.
SCI clearance is required, which means a lengthy background investigation.
Fort Meade is a long commute from Manassas; telework is available but the job is not remote.
